headline: Central Bank of Kenya Warns Commercial Banks Over Capital Shortfalls
summary: The Central Bank of Kenya announced plans to summon commercial banks to explain their strategies for meeting minimum capital requirements.
why: Central bank capital adequacy mandates regulate bank leverage and solvency to safeguard the stability of the domestic financial system.

impacts.name: Kenyan Commercial Banks
impacts.why: Regulator scrutiny over minimum capital requirements.
